launch_evidence.quote: Continued growth for in-line products & strengthened momentum from New Product Portfolio; two new launches YTD with Opdualag & Camzyos

series_start_reason: First quarter with a printed figure: the second-quarter 2022 release prints Camzyos $3 million (U.S. only) with a nil prior-year column; the first-quarter 2022 release has no Camzyos product row (FDA approval was April 28, 2022). Camzyos was developed by MyoKardia; BMS's fourth-quarter 2020 release reports 'Completes Acquisition of MyoKardia', before the 2022 approval, so no pre-acquisition sales exist and no issuer join is needed.
search_log: Listed every filing (all forms) for CIK 0000014272 (Bristol-Myers Squibb) via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. the older 'files' pages; selected every 8-K/8-K/A whose items include 2.02 (105 filings, 2004-10-29 to 2026-10-29) and fetched every document in each filing's index.json except the cover document and R*.htm pages; product rows read from Exhibit 99.1 (the file name matching 'ex99.?1' or 'ex991'), whose first product table is the quarter table.

Row rule: first table row of the Exhibit 99.1 whose first cell begins with the product name and whose first figure cell is a number. 2015Q4-2022Q4 releases print worldwide quarter then same quarter a year earlier (2019Q4-2022Q4 also a summary table on the first page, which is the row read); from the 2023Q1 release the columns are U.S., Int'l, WW and the WW (third) figure is used.
Camzyos product row present in every BMS Exhibit 99.1 from 2022Q2 to 2026Q2 (and in the 2026Q3 release).

Full-year checks (quarters against the twelve-month figure of the Q4 release): 2023: quarters sum to 231; twelve-month figure 231 (current column of the 2023Q4 release); 2024: quarters sum to 602; twelve-month figure 602 (current column of the 2024Q4 release); 2025: quarters sum to 1068; twelve-month figure 1,068 (current column of the 2025Q4 release)
